completeness.why: All five bulk actions take the hidden/hidden-group/income-outside-tracking choice from shouldBudgetCategory (setZero's hidden exception selected by an explicit 'zero' argument; the averages' SQL now only reads non-deleted rows plus group_hidden), and both sign inversions (set3MonthAvg and setNMonthAvg) go through averageToBudgetAmount.

interface.why: The preserved setZero inconsistency is explicit, but it is selected by an action-name enum ('copy' | 'zero' | 'average') in which 'copy' and 'average' behave identically, rather than a parameter naming the real variation (whether hidden categories are included); isTrackingBudget passed in and averageToBudgetAmount are reasonable.
